title: Swirl
tagline: Swirl - the decentralized ad platform that puts privacy first, rewards publishers, and offers easy npm package integration. Say goodbye to invasive ads and hello to a better web experience.
description:
Swirl is a decentralised advertisement platform that provides an easy-to-use npm package SDK for integrating Adsense into your website or application. With Swirl, you can easily monetize your content with location-based advertisements and a reward system for publishers.
For advertisers, Swirl makes it easy to create and manage campaigns for their companies. Advertisers can create targeted campaigns based on location, demographics, and other factors, and easily monitor their performance through Swirl's intuitive dashboard.
Swirl's reward system for publishers is designed to incentivize quality content creation and engagement. Publishers earn rewards based on the engagement metrics of their content, such as clicks, views, and shares.
Location-based advertisement monetization is a powerful feature of Swirl. Advertisers can target their ads to specific geographic locations, allowing them to reach the right audience at the right time. Publishers benefit from location-based ads as well, as they can earn more revenue by displaying ads that are relevant to their audience's location.
Swirl's campaign creation tools are designed to be easy and intuitive. Advertisers can quickly create campaigns and set their targeting criteria, and Swirl takes care of the rest. With Swirl, advertisers can focus on their message and leave the technical details to the platform.
In summary, Swirl is a powerful advertisement platform that provides an easy-to-use SDK for Adsense integration, a reward system for publishers, location-based advertisement monetization, and easy campaign creation tools for advertisers. Whether you're a publisher or an advertiser, Swirl can help you monetize your content and reach your target audience.
how_its_made:
To power Swirl's advertisement platform, we utilized Polybase, a decentralized database, to store campaign details securely. The use of Polybase ensures that data is not only accessible but also safe from external attacks.

To facilitate transactions and implement the reward system, we used Optimism and Scroll L2 blockchains. The use of these blockchains allows Swirl to perform transactions quickly, efficiently, and securely. Optimism is a Layer 2 Ethereum scaling solution that provides fast and low-cost transactions while maintaining Ethereum's security guarantees. Scroll is also a Layer 2 blockchain that provides fast, low-cost transactions with a high degree of security.

By combining Polybase, Optimism, and Scroll L2 blockchains, Swirl can provide a robust, secure, and efficient advertisement platform. This ensures that the platform can handle the transactional demands of the reward system and location-based advertisement monetization, allowing advertisers and publishers to focus on their content while leaving the technical details to the platform.

and we also used PUSH Protocol for notify publishers and advertisers of important events such as campaign updates, engagement metrics, and rewards earned.
